title: ValiAssist: Scaling LLM-generated Programming Feedback Validation by Demonstration
abstract: arXiv:2610.27248v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative AI can create programming feedback at scale, but validating its alignment with instructors' pedagogical goals and strategies remains challenging. Instructors may struggle to fully specify validation criteria upfront, as these often emerge through inspecting concrete examples and revising misaligned feedback. We present ValiAssist, a validation-by-demonstration system that infers reusable validation logic from instructors' revisions of AI-generated feedback and allows instructors to inspect and refine that logic as it is applied across other student submissions. In a comparative study with 16 instructors, ValiAssist helped instructors create and refine validation criteria, producing feedback that better aligned with their pedagogical intent (91% vs. 57%) and more than doubling the accuracy of correcting problematic criteria (77% vs. 32%). Our findings suggest that validation by demonstration can help instructors turn judgment

translated_title: ValiAssist：通过演示示例规模化验证大语言模型生成的编程反馈
translated_abstract: 生成式AI能够大规模创建编程反馈，但验证其是否符合教师的教学目标和策略仍然具有挑战性。教师可能难以预先完整地指定验证标准，因为这些标准往往是在检查具体示例和修改不符合要求的反馈的过程中逐渐形成的。我们提出了ValiAssist，这是一个基于演示示例的验证系统，它从教师对AI生成反馈的修改中推断出可复用的验证逻辑，并允许教师在该逻辑应用于其他学生提交的作业时对其进行检查和完善。在一项涉及16名教师的对比研究中，ValiAssist帮助教师创建和完善验证标准，生成的反馈更好地符合他们的教学意图（91% 对 57%），修正问题标准的准确性提高了一倍以上（77% 对 32%）。我们的研究结果表明，基于演示示例的验证可以帮助教师将判断力转化为可规模化的验证流程。
tldr: ValiAssist通过从教师对AI生成反馈的修改中学习可复用的验证逻辑，实现了LLM生成编程反馈的大规模验证，使反馈与教师教学意图的契合度从57%提升至91%，修正问题标准的准确性从32%提升至77%。
en_tdlr: ValiAssist is a validation-by-demonstration system that infers reusable validation logic from instructors' revisions of AI-generated programming feedback, improving pedagogical alignment from 57% to 91% and doubling the accuracy of correcting problematic criteria.
